vetSays.line: 🛡️ Robin, Kieran, Nargiz, Dmitri and Grace met them at the door — 5 put down. Robin, Kieran, Nargiz, Dmitri, Grace are hurt.
🛡️ Kieran, Nargiz, Dmitri, Ivy and Meera met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 driven off. Kieran, Nargiz, Dmitri, Ivy, Meera are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Nargiz just put down Chorus Line... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Dmitri just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Dmitri just put down Ad Break... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Robin, Kieran, Nargiz and Dmitri met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 barely walked away. Robin, Nargiz, Dmitri are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Dmitri just put down The Redactor... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
🛡️ Robin, Kieran and Dmitri met them at the door — 3 put down. Robin, Kieran, Dmitri are hurt.

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
★ IDENTIFIED (maybe): European Elder. Sanne is sure — "European Elder, see the leaves?" — and you have no reason to doubt them. Yet.
📓 Codex: Sanne taught me European Elder (fireside).
Sanne passes Purslane around the fire — calling it "European Elder" like they've always known. The others nod along, and just like that the wrong name is loose in the village.
The fire burns low. One new line in the journal: European Elder — named and noted.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Elif just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
Elif: "Walked past a good stand of european elder. Worth remembering where."
Nermine: "The european elder patch is fruiting again. Somebody should get out there."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Siqi just put down Loud-Eyes... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Siqi met them at the door — 1 put down.
